The '''2019–20 California Baptist Lancers men's basketball team''' represented [[California Baptist University]] (CBU) in the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Lancers, led by seventh-year head coach [[Rick Croy]], played their home games at the [[CBU Events Center]] in [[Riverside, California]] as members of the [[Western Athletic Conference]] (WAC). They finished the season 21–10, 10–6 in WAC play, to finish in second place.

The season marked CBU's second year of a four-year transition period from [[NCAA Division II|Division II]] to [[NCAA Division I|Division I]]. As a result, the Lancers were not eligible for NCAA postseason play and could not participate in the [[2020 WAC men's basketball tournament|WAC tournament]]. They were eligible to play in the [[CollegeInsider.com Postseason Tournament|CIT]] or [[2020 College Basketball Invitational|CBI]], if invited.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://cbulancers.com/news/2018/7/13/general-cbu-accepted-into-ncaa-division-i-reclassification.aspx|title=CBU Accepted Into NCAA Division I Reclassification|website=CBU Athletics|language=en|access-date=2020-03-02}}</ref> However, all postseason play was cancelled due to they [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]].

==Previous season==
The [[2018–19 California Baptist Lancers men's basketball team|Lancers]] finished the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2018–19 season]] 16–15, 7–9 in WAC play, to finish in a tie for fifth place. They were ineligible to participate in the [[2019 WAC men's basketball tournament|WAC tournament]] due to their transition from Division II to Division I. They received an invite to the [[2019 College Basketball Invitational|CBI]], where they lost to [[2018–19 Loyola Marymount Lions men's basketball team|Loyola Marymount]] in the first round.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Minyard |first=Mike |date=2025-11-03 |title=Lancers Battle in CBI Postseason Tournament |url=https://cbulancers.com/news/2019/3/21/mens-basketball-lancers-battle-in-cbi-postseason-tournament |access-date=2025-09-29 |website=CBU Athletics |language=en}}</ref>
